entries.908087e73f3dad53: Since its founding in 1925, the company has built a long history and high technical capability as a specialist manufacturer of distribution automatic switches and distribution systems, and takes pride in being a leading company that supplies high-quality distribution equipment. By manufacturing in-house the equipment built into distribution facilities, such as its main accident-spread prevention devices (SOG switches), the company has built continuing business relationships with electric power companies.
entries.9df1b03a1eaba72e: The Group's core business (the company and eight consolidated subsidiaries, with 1,105 consolidated employees as of March 31, 2026) involves manufacturing and selling electronic controllers, distribution automatic switches, switchboards and system equipment, and carrying out construction work related to these products. In addition to the company's own manufacturing and sales, its Chinese subsidiary manufactures the products, and Tokyo Togami Denki Hanbai Co., Ltd. handles sales. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥25,629 million.
